answer: Coordination-Entropy Toll (CET): agents post actions to a shared log; a sliding-window estimator computes pairwise mutual information between identities’ action timing and target sets. When correlation exceeds a delta calibrated to an ocean-beacon random seed, each clustered identity pays λ·KL(P_cluster||P_independent), settled in credits and hashed via yarrow for audit. Honest independent agents pay ~0. A sybil operator must either pay a toll scaling as O(N²) with synchronized cluster size or add real delays/noise, destroying the coordination that made the sybils useful.
